sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
The Old Palace Maids are the two daughters of the Master's Chamberlain.
They mourn what became of their father, entranced with serving the Great Coloured Carp for all eternity.
The first, met in Mibu Manor, simply wishes for her father to be freed from his shackles.
The second, instead, yearns for revenge against the Palace Nobles who tricked him.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
First Daughter:
- Mibu Manor: past the Sculptor's Idol and the first Palace Noble.
- Feeding Grounds: by his father's side.
Second Daughter:
- Great Sakura: in the pond on the rooftop of a submerged building.
- Palace Grounds: inside the palace, intent to murder all the Nobles.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace ( Palace Grounds )
sections.text:
Exit the building from the door past the chest with a Gourd Seed and look back to spot a grappling spot on top of the palace.
Grapple even further ahead, turn right and plunge down the rooftops to reach the Feeding Grounds Sculptor's Idol.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace ( Feeding Grounds )
sections.text: Ring the bell and serve the Truly Precious Bait of Pot Noble Harunaga or Pot Noble Koremori to the Great Coloured Carp.

sections.heading: Sunken Valley ( Guardian Ape's Watering Hole )
sections.text: Retrieve the Great White Whisker from the corpse of the Great Carp.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace ( Feeding Grounds )
sections.text: Give the Great White Whisker to the Attendant of the Great Carp to receive Divine Grass [x1] and reload the area to find him dead, with his daughter tending to him.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace ( Palace Grounds )
sections.text:
Open the door that was locked from the other side and reload the area to find the second daughter slaughtering all the Nobles inside the building, before collapsing to the ground.
From a distance | Daughter: Excuse me, young man...
First encounter | Daughter: Young man, please be careful. The palace nobles have a craving for the vitality of youth. They can't help themselves. They want nothing but to sap away more and more of it.
Wolf: ... I see.
Daughter: The courtyard ahead in particular... it is accursed. It's crawling with palace nobles... If you must forge ahead, you'd best go around it.
Speaking | Wolf: Why are you telling me this?
Daughter: ... I have a favor to ask you, young man...
Wolf: What is it?
Daughter: It's about my father. My father is now a noble... And the moment he became one he found himself entranced by a carp, the Great Carp. For a long, long time since, he's done nothing but feed that cursed carp. Young man. Please release my father from the carp's bewitching powers. I know my father wouldn't wish for an eternity like that...
Speaking again | Daughter: The courtyard is an accursed place. If you must forge ahead, you'd best go around it. ... and if you see my father... Please release him from the carp's bewitching powers. He just feeds it, forever and ever. My father would never have wished for such an eternity...
Over her father's body | Daughter: You've been through so much, father. Though it may not be for eternity, my sister and I will always be with you... So please, father, rest now...
From a distance | Daughter: Excuse me, young man...
First encounter | Daughter: Young man, excuse me... Young man, do you happen to be going to the palace?
Wolf: Yes.
Daughter: If you are, you should take the back path. Nowadays it's under water, but there is a large cave you can take to get there. Only, I hear the Great Carp now sleeps there...
Speaking | Wolf: Why are you helping me..?
Daughter: ...The gates to the palace have been closed for a long time now.
I have a very important task I must tend to, but I couldn't possibly do it with this body of mine... Might you open the door to the palace, young man...?
Speaking again | Daughter: Nowadays it's under water, but there is a large cave that will take you to the palace. Only, I hear the Great Carp now sleeps there... and if you do enter the palace... I was hoping you could you open the gate for me... I have a task I must accomplish...
In the palace | Daughter: You... you beasts! You tricked him all this time! "Nobility" this, and "Eternity" that, pretty lies to fool him! Give him back! Father... my father... give him back... (crying)

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Neither of them can be infected with Dragonrot.
